mapper.select: SELECT m.match_num AS matchNum, TO_CHAR(m.match_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')AS matchDate, m.match_time AS matchTime, m.home_score AS homeScore, m.away_score AS awayScore, m.apply_id AS applyId FROM clubJoin cj JOIN player_record pr ON pr.clubJoin_num = cj.clubJoin_num JOIN match m ON m.match_num = pr.match_num WHERE cj.memberIdx = #{memberIdx}
